question: What percentage of tests will be positive for human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in the United States for the week ending October 17, 2026, in CDC data?
resolution_criteria: Resolves to the percent of tests positive for human metapneumovirus (HMPV) in the United States for the week ending 2026-10-17 in CDC's the National Respiratory and Enteric Virus Surveillance System (NREVSS) percent positivity data (data.cdc.gov dataset rgnm-fkqb), as posted on 2026-10-30.
research:
## HMPV test positivity in CDC NREVSS data, research for the week ending 2026-10-17

### 1. Resolution source
- The question resolves on CDC dataset rgnm-fkqb (NREVSS percent positivity), using the National level, pathogen HMPV, Combined Type row, as posted on 2026-10-30. The dataset keeps only its latest posting, so it gets revised from week to week. [data.cdc.gov](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)
- The latest national HMPV data available as of 2026-09-28 covers the week ending 2026-09-19 (CDC posts on Fridays, so that week was likely posted around 2026-09-25):
  - 2026-09-19: 0.72% (142 of 19,795 tests)
  - 2026-09-12: 0.63%
  - 2026-09-05: 0.78%
  - 2026-08-29: 0.57%
  - 2026-08-22: 0.67%
  - 2026-08-15: 0.77%
  - 2026-08-08: 0.85%
  - 2026-08-01: 1.14%
- Caveat: I read these figures from the dataset's current version, so earlier postings may differ slightly after routine revisions. [data.cdc.gov](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)
- The spring 2026 season was large. Positivity was 5.49% in the week ending 2026-04-18, then fell to 1.76% by 2026-07-04. It has been flat at roughly 0.57 to 0.85% since early August. [data.cdc.gov](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)

### 2. Current status
- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The target week is about 4 weeks after the last available data point.
- Current levels (about 0.6 to 0.8%) sit inside the question's 0 to 1.5 range. They are higher than late September in 2023, 2024 and 2025.

### 3. Recent news
- 2026-06: a medRxiv preprint on HMPV spatiotemporal dynamics appeared. I did not review its findings. [medRxiv](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.64898/2026.06.01.26354616v1.article-info)
- 2026-03: news coverage of a widespread HMPV surge, with high wastewater levels in California, New York and Chicago and detections in all regions. [NTD](https://www.ntd.com/hmpv-respiratory-virus-spreads-across-us-from-connecticut-to-california-in-winter-and-spring_1130493.html), [California Insider](https://californiainsider.com/california-news/health/cdc-little-known-virus-with-no-vaccine-spreading-in-us-5997067), [Fox News](https://www.foxnews.com/health/highly-contagious-virus-no-treatment-spreading-rapidly-through-western-state.print)
- 2026-02-10: CDC's consumer page says HMPV typically circulates in late winter and spring. [FluTrackers/CDC](https://flutrackers.com/forum/forum/national-international-government-ngo-preparation-response/cdc/1031531-cdc-information-on-human-metapneumovirus-february-10-2026)
- I found no news about HMPV activity in fall 2026.

### 4. Base rates and seasonality
National HMPV percent positive, from the latest week of September to mid-October (same dataset): [data.cdc.gov](https://data.cdc.gov/resource/rgnm-fkqb.json)

| Year | ~Sep 20 | ~Sep 27 | ~Oct 4 | ~Oct 11 | ~Oct 18 | Change, ~Sep 20 to ~Oct 18 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2021 | 0.64 (9/18) | 0.95 | 1.10 | 1.32 | 1.77 (10/16) | +1.13 (atypical post-COVID resurgence) |
| 2022 | 0.66 (9/17) | 0.94 | 1.00 | 1.46 | 1.11 (10/15) | +0.45 |
| 2023 | 0.27 (9/16) | 0.22 | 0.24 | 0.41 | 0.34 (10/14) | +0.07 |
| 2024 | 0.35 (9/21) | 0.40 | 0.41 | 0.45 | 0.57 (10/19) | +0.22 |
| 2025 | 0.42 (9/20) | 0.41 | 0.52 | 0.51 | 0.68 (10/18) | +0.26 |

- In every year from 2021 to 2025, the mid-October value was higher than the mid/late-September value. In 2022 to 2025 the rise was about 0.07 to 0.45 points, or about 25 to 70% in relative terms.
- Week-to-week noise in 2026 has been about ±0.1 to 0.2 points (for example 0.57, 0.78, 0.63, 0.72).
- 2026 is running higher than 2023 to 2025 at this time of year (0.72 vs 0.27 to 0.42) and close to 2022 (0.66). This may be leftover activity from the unusually large spring 2026 season, which tapered slowly over the summer.
- Weekly test volume is about 18,000 to 20,000, so one week's count of detections (about 115 to 170) carries meaningful sampling noise.
- Note: October 2025 reporting overlapped with the federal government shutdown (2025-10-01 to 2025-11-12). Those values are as they appear now, after revisions.

### 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold markets, and no expert forecasts, for HMPV percent positivity.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Weekly NREVSS updates (Fridays) will add the weeks ending 2026-09-26, 10-03, 10-10 and 10-17. Earlier weeks can also be revised up to the 2026-10-30 posting, which is what resolves the question.
- Fall school terms and the usual autumn rise in respiratory viruses (RSV, flu) typically come with a gradual rise in HMPV through October and November. The main HMPV peak is usually in late winter to spring.
- Weather: no specific weather link matters at this horizon. I did not pull a seasonal outlook.
